Etizolam and F-Phenibut Combo
3mg etizolam spaced 2hrs augmented by 230-300mg f-phenibut
T-00 took 2mg etizolam pellets
T+130 very pronounced body and mind sedation that I love of benzos.
T+2hrs post etizolam I decide to consume 250-300mg of f-phenibut
T+3.5hrs post etizolam ingestion accompanied by 250-300mg f-phenibut definite a synergestic effect is present but in the best way possible
T+5hr post ingestion a tranquil and much body and muscle relaxation seems to be a fantastic augment...
Will be a great day thanks to the lack of amnesic properties of the chemicals taken in moderation. Fantastic experience definite potentiation across the two stacked with the 3mg etizolam seems like a perfect non amnesic experience.
